stories.title: A severe winter hit the northern steppe in year 3
stories.summary: Snow lay for weeks and the hibernating grazers that had fattened in autumn came through; the rest of the herd halved.

stories.title: A player's predator lineage quietly became wild foxes
stories.summary: Breeding with a nearby wild species turned most of the lineage's alleles wild: 65% of them now trace back to the wild fox.
